needsBespoke.why: Ixtal's Impact (E) only deals damage if a grabbed target collides with terrain, which is a positional/geometric condition (dummy is stationary, no walls specified) that none of the closed-list primitives directly resolve into a deterministic damage-fight behavior; also Q's three-part empowered-attack sequence with a distinct final-hit formula and an alternate end-cast (Upheaval) that shares state with Q is more layered than a single primitive captures cleanly (empowered-attack + nth-hit-or-cast + recast-or-multipart + cooldown-manipulation combined).

proposal: Pre-cast Shattered Earth (Q) to arm the next 3 basic attacks and reset the attack timer.
Auto-attack the dummy three times to consume the empowered attacks, landing the final (3rd) hit for the bonus max-health damage and applying/refreshing Quaking stacks each hit.
Cast Seismic Bastion (W) on cooldown for its magic damage burst (its shield is irrelevant in the damage fight).
Recast Shattered Earth (Q) as soon as it comes off cooldown (further reduced by the empowered-attack cooldown-restart mechanic) and repeat the 3-attack empowered sequence.
Weave normal basic attacks between Q cycles to keep stacking Quaking to 3 stacks and keep the P damage-over-time ticking continuously.
Cast Impale (R) once available (after cast-time windup) for its flat+AP magic damage burst; if timed while Shattered Earth is active, this auto-fires Upheaval as well for extra Q-final-hit damage.

Omit Ixtal's Impact (E) from the core loop, or treat it purely as a plain-cast for its direct pin damage if the human ruling allows an assumed-wall-collision variant; otherwise skip it since the stationary dummy fight has no terrain to trigger its damage.
